Steve Buckingham has lead a storied life in the music business, first as an in- demand studio guitarist and subsequently as a highly successful producer and record company executive. He has earned four Grammy awards and been involved with 20 gold and 12 platinum records.
Steve was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 25, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have Steve Buckingham on campus today at Hamilton College. Thanks for being here.
It’s nice to be here, in a blizzard or whatever this is.
It is really quite annoying outside, yes.
But it’s a beautiful campus. Coming in last night it looked like a Currier & Ives card, so yeah.
